text:
Elena: Hi team — filed expense for Oslo trip. Bought a local SIM on my personal card (receipt attached, 500 NOK). Should we reimburse to my bank or to the card? Also which project code? PRJ-VIK-42 or general travel?
Tom: Policy: telecom on personal card = reimbursable. Use project code if the trip was billable. Did you meet with client?
Elena: Yes two billed meetings for PRJ-VIK-42. Receipt doesn't show vendor VAT number (Telenor kiosk). Shows 125 NOK tax line but no VAT reg.
Rachel: VAT reclaim needs vendor VAT reg number. Reimburse gross to employee and tag VAT as unclaimable. Add note: "SIM for client work, VAT unclaimable".
expense-bot: Flag: personal-card telecom reimbursement requires manager attestation and expense note. Suggested tag: "SIM for local data — client work".
Elena: Added note and attached pic of receipt. Felix DM'd approval. Felix: I approve reimbursing 500 NOK to Elena and charging PRJ-VIK-42.
VendorOps: For client billing: do we want this as reimbursable on the client invoice or absorb under travel? If billable, we'll include a reimbursable line and need code BILLABLE_TECH.
Tom: Finance: reimburse to employee by bank transfer and allocate to BILLABLE_TECH (project PRJ-VIK-42). Accounting ref GL-TRVL-2024-07-15. Please include manager approval screenshot in Concur.
expense-bot: Action logged: reimbursement queued. Reminder: attach manager signoff for audit.
Elena: Bank details updated in Concur. Thanks — please confirm when payment posts.
VendorOps: Noted — will mark as reimbursable for next client invoice.
Felix: All good from manager side.
